model.name: Lobby correct name on first load
model.description: The lobby renders the correct profile name immediately on connect, never blank or a default placeholder that only corrects on a second reload.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "lobby renders correct profile name immediately on connect, not blank/default until second reload."

acceptanceCriteria.text: On first render the member name is resolved as: URL ?name= > client.getProfile()?.name > localStorage 'rawbin-name' > 'User <rand>' — the authoritative server profile name is preferred over an empty localStorage snapshot.
On a warm profile cache the correct name shows on the FIRST paint — no blank/default flash, no second reload required.
On MSG.PROFILE_UPDATED with a non-empty profile.name, memberName is set to that name and persisted to localStorage 'rawbin-name'.
The PROFILE_UPDATED handler updates BOTH the #member-name input value AND the rb-avatar 'name' attribute (not just the input) so the visible lobby name+avatar block self-heals.
A PROFILE_UPDATED with an empty/absent name is ignored (no clobbering the current name).
Verified headless against the running app (Strict Verify Bar): first connect on a fresh device shows the real profile name with zero second-reload.

testScenarios.name: name precedence order
testScenarios.given: a RoomBrowser constructed with ?name absent, getProfile().name='Marcel', localStorage empty
testScenarios.then: memberName === 'Marcel' (profile name beats the empty localStorage / random fallback)

testScenarios.name: correct name on first paint (warm)
testScenarios.given: a warm profile cache on connect
testScenarios.then: the name+avatar block shows the real name on the first paint; no default flash, no second reload

testScenarios.name: PROFILE_UPDATED self-heals name+avatar
testScenarios.given: the lobby rendered with a provisional name
testScenarios.then: memberName='Marcel D', localStorage 'rawbin-name'='Marcel D', #member-name.value='Marcel D', AND rb-avatar[name]='Marcel D'

testScenarios.name: empty update ignored
testScenarios.when: a PROFILE_UPDATED arrives with no name
testScenarios.then: the handler returns early and the displayed name stays 'Marcel'
